issue_context.title: Windows file dialog doesn't support multiple file patterns in a single file filter
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

v4.2.dev.custom_build [ba54c3455]

### System information

Windows 10.0.22621 - GLES3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 with Max-Q Design (NVIDIA; 31.0.15.3667) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10750H CPU @ 2.60GHz (12 Threads)

### Issue description

The `FileDialogue` class allows for multiple file types to be specified for a single file filter. Example: `"Supported images (*.png,  *.jpg, *.jpeg"`. This makes it convenient for the user to be able to find the file they're looking for. However, when using `DisplayServer.file_dialog_show()` on Windows, using this syntax does not yield the expected results. Due to how the strings are parsed, the string that produces the filter above for FileDialogue (`"*.png,*.jpg,*.jpeg;Supported Images"`) causes the separate file extensions to be merged together, preventing the use of multiple extensions as filters.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a file dialogue using `DisplayServer.file_dialog_show()`
2. Set the filters array to include a filter set with multiple file patterns, such as `"*.png,*.jpg,*.jpeg;Supported Images"`

### Minimal reproduction project

[windows_file_dialogue_test.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/12641981/windows_file_dialogue_test.zip)
